vignette: A school-age child presents for a routine visit. Both mandibular permanent first molars are fully erupted and have deep occlusal fissures that trap food debris. One molar has a sound occlusal surface. The other has a noncavitated occlusal carious lesion with no cavitation.
stem: Which approach to these two molars is best supported by current guidance?

options.text: Place a sealant on both molars.
Seal the sound molar and leave the molar with the noncavitated lesion unsealed, with monitoring.
Seal the sound molar and use fluoride varnish alone on the molar with the noncavitated lesion.
Use fluoride varnish alone on both molars instead of sealants.
